visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with blonde-highlighted hair, wearing a black cap and a grey zip-up hoodie, stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She holds a small white box with Snoopy artwork, smiling warmly at the camera. (2) She removes her cap to reveal visibly oily hair roots. She uses her fingers to lift and point at the greasy strands, looking slightly distressed to emphasize the problem. (3) Close-up on a small cylindrical container with a light blue cap and Snoopy illustration. She holds it up to the lens for clear identification. (4) She removes the cap to show a built-in white sponge puff applicator on top of the container. (5) She unscrews the top section of the container, peels off a transparent protective seal, and shows the fine white powder contents inside. (6) Returning to a medium shot, she dabs the sponge puff directly onto her scalp at the crown and forehead area several times. (7) She uses both hands to vigorously rub and massage her hair, fluffing it up from the roots to distribute the product. (8) She presents her hair, which now appears voluminous, dry, and matte. She smiles and poses confidently for the camera. (9) A split-screen graphic appears, contrasting her oily 'Before' state in a small circle with her refreshed 'After' state in the main frame. (10) She gives a thumbs-up and continues talking about the product's benefits, eventually ending with a screen displaying the black 'Moody' logo on a white background.
